title: PESTLE Analysis Detail
welcome_lead: Six lenses on the external environment.
meta_desc: A-Level Analysis: PESTLE in depth with examples.
final_note: PESTLE is the macro counterpart to SWOT's micro lens.

concepts.def: Growth, inflation, interest rates, exchange rates.

walkthroughs.body_html: For each letter, list factors and rate likelihood and impact. A retailer might flag rising minimum wage (Legal/Economic) and online shift (Technological/Social).
Technological shifts trigger social changes; legal changes follow political ones. PESTLE letters are connected - analyse the chain, not just the bullet point.
The top 3 to 5 PESTLE issues should be tied to concrete strategic responses: new investment, exit plans, pricing reviews. A PESTLE without action is wasted ink.
